name: Chakwal

queries.query: Chakwal Pakistan official cadastral map land records GIS parcel Punjab official
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Punjab Land Records Authority, the Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement (PULSE) parcel-mapping program, and the official Chakwal district revenue office. Public material establishes digital land records and cadastral-map work, but no safely accessible anonymous Chakwal parcel API or downloadable parcel layer was exposed.

queries.query: چکوال پاکستان سرکاری کادستر نقشہ اراضی ریکارڈ GIS
queries.result: Urdu-language discovery returned official Punjab land-record and Chakwal revenue references, including the PLRA Urdu-facing service context and an official online Fard verification page showing Chakwal district/tehsil. It did not expose a public anonymous parcel viewer, safe parcel identity schema, or parcel geometry endpoint.

attemptedRoutes.route: Punjab Land Records Authority landing page
attemptedRoutes.outcome: Public GET/search access succeeded at the site level; the current page is a JavaScript app. It documents PLRA digital land-record services and GIS-linked digitization, but no anonymous parcel query route was exposed in the fetched page.
Public GET succeeded. The page links to the official GIS portal and describes parcel mapping linked to Punjab land records; it is program/portal navigation, not parcel response data.

Web fetch timed out. A direct TLS-verified curl request failed certificate verification (unable to get local issuer certificate). No TLS exception was used because none was authorized; therefore no service configuration, schema, CRS, or bounded parcel response was inspected.
Public page identifies the Deputy Commissioner Chakwal and Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), establishing a local revenue custodian contact context but no public parcel service.
Public page provides district land statistics and administrative context; it is not a cadastral parcel service.

Public verification page was discoverable and shows Chakwal district/tehsil in a land-record workflow. It contains record/owner-related content and was not queried for or retained as parcel data; no geometry or safe native parcel identity was obtained.

Official planning page exposes Chakwal land-use and structure-plan documents. These are planning/land-use maps, explicitly not property/parcel attribution, so no parcel request or sample was retained.

sourceAssessment.localRegistryCustodian: Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA), with the official Chakwal district Deputy Commissioner / Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) as the evidenced local revenue office context.
sourceAssessment.nationalGeneralAgency: Punjab provincial land-record and PULSE GIS programs are general/provincial custodians; no anonymous Chakwal parcel endpoint was evidenced.

runtimeReadiness.reason: No independently qualified public parcel adapter, parcel schema, safe native identity, or bounded parcel geometry response was evidenced. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration/admission.

uncertainty: PULSE/PLRA may expose parcel data through a current browser workflow or restricted/request-based service that could not be safely inspected because the GIS host timed out and failed TLS verification.
The absence of an obtained parcel response is not evidence of citywide absence; the exact WUP point was not used to infer coverage.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe owner/address fields, or TLS verification bypass was used.
